profile.quote: Belum diisi

stories.text:
The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop does not say much, always standing quietly beside everyone else. She seems to have a nickname, "Daff," which Hotori occasionally calls her. Whenever Hotori calls her that, Daffodill looks away, her ears turning completely red. As for the others… if they want to be cut to pieces, they are welcome to try using that name.

Daffodill owns many eyepatches. Though she wears them less now, she still keeps up her collecting habit. Nobody can tell the difference between those eyepatches, but she firmly believes in her taste. Leather ones, patterned ones, ones with especially neat stitching… she carefully sorts them by category and places them in her small collection box.

Daffodill was not born with poor vision; rather, it was the price of her Esper Ability. At nineteen, cruel truth burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope, and since then she could see through anomalies to perceive layers of essence across time and space. Sometimes, glimpsing the truth is not a good thing. She learned about her parents' cause of death, about her own wishful emotional attachments, about needing and being needed… and lost the faith she had relied on for survival. The red-cloaked hero in the picture book silently turned her blade toward Mother, toward that hateful, beating heart that had once falsely given her warmth. If the goddess of vengeance wanted to punish her for this… then so be it.

Daff longed for a happy, beautiful place, and so accidentally embarked on a journey full of metaphors.
So then, what about the ending of the story?
Her life until now was one monopolized by lies. It was a life in which no one needed her… there was no point in continuing. That was what Daffodill had been thinking when she met that slightly tipsy woman. The woman talked about a daffodil growing in the center of the lake, proud and aloof, seemingly impossible for anyone to pick. She naturally needed that flower too, but would not pick it.
A strange woman and a strange flower. What reason did that daffodil have for growing alone there? It must depend on something. Surely it grew that way because it was rooted in others' need for it. When the wind rose, Daffodill heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.

Why not follow the woman and seek answers in the life ahead?

stories.title: The Woman in Red Gloves
stories.text:
She pushed the door open and went inside. The rust-red sea climbed up to her feet and dizziness soon followed, like staring into a kaleidoscope.
At that moment, a pair of hands wearing red gloves covered her eyes.
Ms. T, who happened to be visiting, witnessed the tragedy of her parents alongside her. In her heartbreak, she offered to adopt Daffodill as her daughter. The beautiful girl had lost both parents, and no other relatives would risk being implicated by taking in a child of misfortune… She had always been the one who was not needed. Only Ms. T reached out her hand to her, so she gratefully took her place by Ms. T's side.

stories.title: Mechanical March - I
stories.text:
The trials were cruel. Even though Daffodill was an exceptionally talented child, she still ended up covered in wounds.
Madam T said that, compared to other children, Daffodill could feel pain closer to death itself, and on some level that brought her closer to her parents. The injuries she suffered were more valuable than anyone else's.
Besides, Madam T needed her.
Daffodill did not like pain, but Madam T's words gave her a reason to suffer. She forced herself to believe in Madam T and held her words as truth, devoutly throwing herself into the trials. Once she was ready, she became Madam T's blade, moving through various gray area missions.

stories.title: Mechanical March - II
stories.text:
"Mother, are all charities like this? Like wolves in sheep's clothing from the stories?"
"People have many sides. The brighter the light shines, the darker the shadow becomes. That is the real world."
"They… they cry so often. They wish Mother would not make them hurt so much."
"My flowers have no one to depend on except me. I am willing to provide nourishment, and all I ask in return is to select the one that survives longest and blooms most beautifully… it's only reasonable."
"Besides… crying is only temporary. Look at them, silly child. Are they not smiling now?"
Daffodill looked up and saw the girls laughing together, clustering around Madam T and herself, as if they were embracing a mother they truly loved.

stories.title: Sisters
stories.text:
They would rest together on Madam T's lap, one on each side.
Before sleep, they would clean each other's wounds from the day's trials or quests, like two small animals grooming one another.
But sometimes she would wonder… was she the same as Zankou? Did not resisting the trials and quests mean she was enjoying them?
No. What she enjoyed was the feeling of being needed, and from that lingering warmth, her thoughts drifted towards parental dependence…

stories.title: Perfect Garden's Truth - I
stories.text:
Inconsistent patterns, wall marks with slightly broken lines, a subtle 3-millimeter gap from the bookshelf, a tilt angle differing by about 3 degrees… there was surely a hidden door here. Her eyesight had always been sharp, so she could perceive the truth more easily than most. She could see massive, spectacular, densely packed information files, including personal records of Daffodill and her parents.
They were detailed enough to make one's hair stand on end.
She saw scribbled notes beside her own photo: "beautiful collectible," "important tool for missions."

stories.title: Perfect Garden's Truth - II
stories.text:
Using newborn Daffodill as leverage, Madam T forced Daffodill's parents to spend years away treasure hunting.
Finally, one day, they could no longer bear it.
"Even if we're forced to wander with our daughter, we must tell her the truth… a family must stay together."
However, the controller was watching everything. Daffodill had reached the right age to bloom, and the hunter couple had done all that she wanted. Rebellious pawns were useless. Better eliminate them.

stories.title: Daff
stories.text:
She had never known that a daffodil grew in the center of the lake. She had never seen it as a child. Had it grown after Ms. T took her away?
The woman smiled and raised her wine bottle, inviting her to toast. Daffodill looked at her swaying, carefree manner and felt inexplicably angry.
"I have already lost everything. What exactly am I supposed to toast to?"
"Do toasts need reasons? Well… then… to the despair of having nothing, to skies never witnessed. And to the one and only daffodil in the center of this lake."
"…Do you want to pick that flower too?"
"Mmm… I need that flower. But I will not pick it."
Meeting Daffodill's look that clearly said this was contradictory, the woman tapped her forehead with the wet tip of her umbrella.
"Who decided that needing something means you must take it? I only need it to exist, so I can drink something fine while admiring it like this. That is enough for me."
When the wind rose, she heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.
Perhaps… there really was a daffodil growing in the center of the lake.

stories.text:
Whenever someone new joins the much-feared ETD, Bureau employees can't help wondering: Is another terrifying or high-maintenance weirdo joining up?
The only exception seems to be the lieutenant of ETD-6, who won everyone's trust and affection with ease from the moment she showed up. She fit right in, as if she'd always been there!
The creation of ETD-6 had been a sudden, somewhat experimental decision. Rumors had only just begun circulating that the director had personally promoted a young man with a strategically valuable Esper Ability and tasked him with forming a squad. No one had even seen him yet. Yet the "lieutenant" had already made herself at home, moving from office to office and building relationships throughout the Bureau. She helped the new squad establish smooth communication and cooperation with the other departments.
Even though there were fewer rumors about her past before joining than there were about the reclusive captain's… everyone still accepted her in no time.

Elyms is known for her kindness, wit, and knack for looking after people's feelings. Even strangers quickly feel like old friends around her and find themselves opening up. She makes friends with all kinds of people in no time. As the officer responsible for ETD-6's internal and external communications and information flow, she also seems to have an extensive network both inside and outside the Bureau, which is invaluable when investigating Anomaly Crimes.
In her free time, you can often find her on the phone, browsing Bagel, or chatting with online friends. And she never lets social media distract her from her real-life friends. It's hard to imagine how much social energy it takes to make sure no one who talks to her ever feels ignored.
She has another curious habit: she effortlessly adjusts her way of speaking to suit whoever she's talking to. Maybe that's why people's impressions of Elyms can differ slightly in the details, but everyone agrees she's cheerful, friendly, and incredibly easy to get along with. She's a real social butterfly.

"You always reply so fast! I just sent you a message, and you already answered!"
"Haha~ If I know what I want to say, I just go ahead and send it!"
"But you're always chatting with so many friends at once. How do you manage to reply to so many people?"
"I'm a really, really fast typist! Whoosh—whoosh! Want to see? Oh, and I have more than one device. I can type with both hands flying, and there's voice input too~!"
"Why do I always feel like I know you? Like we were really close a long time ago."
"I've actually felt that way too. So… do you remember anything more specific?"
"Let me think… Hmm, before… where were you? What did you do?"
"Well, maybe I was… someone you could vent to online? Customer support for a platform? A counselor? Something like that~" she replied with a half-joking air.

stories.title: #Dial-Up Internet
stories.text:
"I was just on the phone with you, and now you're here!" Around Elyms, that hardly counts as coincidence or fate.
Elyms explains that when someone calls her, she can send a projection of herself along the established connection and materialize wherever that friend is, ready to help with whatever they need.
"That's so convenient~!" "Right~?"
People tend to focus on how quickly she can travel by phone and overlook the part about providing help. Few stop to wonder why that help comes in so many forms, almost as though her abilities can change to suit the person calling.
Those extra thoughtful touches only work while the call is connected, though. Maybe the line doesn't just connect to Elyms's phone. Maybe it also connects to a digital storage space, allowing her to bring whatever the caller needs and materialize it along with her.

So far, all of that could still be explained as part of a phone-based ability. But a few questions remain.
How can she slip into computers and manipulate files?
How can she roam the vast ocean of networks, bypassing every block?
How can she pull magical equipment straight out of video games and use it?
Of course, these abilities are incredibly useful in investigations and combat. No one's complaining about that. But… what do any of them have to do with phones? Elyms has never offered an explanation. She simply uses them as naturally as breathing, moving through the digital world as though this, too, were something she'd always been able to do.

stories.title: A Retro Gaming Urban Legend
stories.text:
From Dream Isle was a free text adventure released on PC by an anonymous solo developer. Nearly all traces of its origins and related information have been lost amid the internet's rapid evolution. What is known is that it was made roughly 20 years ago, though its exact release date is impossible to determine.
There is no shortage of fragmentary information about the game, though some of it may be fabricated. Today, no one can find a copy of a game that matches its description. In other words, no one can prove they've actually played it; only a few preserved screenshots and text fragments have made their way online.
Its description alone evoked a gentle, faraway atmosphere. And with the game itself lost to the ever-changing internet, that atmosphere has taken on a wistful, almost dreamlike quality… It remains a topic of discussion among retro game enthusiasts.

The game has only one character: an elf girl who lives alone on a tiny, isolated island. Her eyes glow like a bioluminescent sea, her hair is soft as clouds, and a big blue bow adorns her head. Though her life seems nearly endless, she retains an innocence and curiosity untouched by time.
The gameplay is just as unusual. You collect bottles washed up on the beach and read the messages inside. Using the choices and keywords you collect, you can write your own letters with considerable freedom, then send them out to sea in bottles and leave their delivery to chance. Years, or even decades, later, a reply arrives, revealing how the world has changed. This cycle continues for a thousand years, until the story reaches its ending.
The island's seasonal backdrops and the girl's character portrait barely change throughout the game. The art is sparse, but the sheer volume of text is staggering. The creator's intent was to show the outside world's development over long stretches of time solely through the messages in the bottles, while the girl, removed from the rest of humanity, imagined and judged the world she learned about in fragments with childlike wonder. The result was a sprawling, branching visual novel meant to be read at a leisurely pace.
The most fascinating part is that every letter sent out has a chance to set off a "butterfly effect," with each effect influencing the others and dramatically changing the story's course. A single word choice in a letter might end a war years earlier, for instance, while a different turn of phrase might delay a technological revolution by decades. Those changes then affect every letter received after that point, leaving the version of the "outside world" the girl reads about in bottles a thousand years later open to infinite possibilities…

In some endings, the girl continues to live on the island as always, but the world falls silent. Perhaps no one uses such a primitive means of communication as message bottles anymore. Perhaps the world has been destroyed. Either way, no new replies ever come. The girl becomes a "mystery."
In some endings, the girl never leaves, but one of her pen pals somehow finds the island and visits, bringing a whole box of wondrous things from the outside world and sharing in her joy. The visitor brings the world's fascinating variety to the little island. The girl remains an "elf."
In some endings, the girl accepts a pen pal's invitation and finally decides to leave the island, set sail, and meet them. At last, she forms a real connection with the vast world she had spent so long gazing at and imagining from afar, in a more direct and intimate way. The girl joins "humanity."
There's also a rumor—supposedly made up offhand by some internet user—about one of the game's hidden endings. Since it feels entirely unlike any of the endings above, it's considered extremely unlikely to be real:
A chain of butterfly effects leads to a sudden catastrophe. The girl and her island sink beneath the sea, and what happens after that is unknown. The ripples and bubbles left behind as she sinks, like her final message, set off one last butterfly effect… In a mysterious sea, a tremendous storm quietly begins to gather around that point. You could say it only stirs the air. But because it is air, it can travel, reach, fill, and sweep across the entire world.
The girl gave rise to a "monster."

stories.title: From Dream Isle: An Overview
stories.text:
Blue, clear as the sky.
Blue, dark as the deep sea.

Today, I fished another message from a human out of the biggest reservoir in the world~
When I uncork this bottle, what beautifully patterned butterfly will flutter out?
Why send words out into the emptiness? Is it because you want someone to hear them? Because you hope for an answer?
It might take a very, very long time. Even the ways we communicate now still leave so much to chance…
So take your time and pour your heart into a very, very long letter—

stories.title: Info Tech 101
stories.text:
Hey there, friend! If you've made it this far, you must be pretty patient~
I don't know when you first found out about us or read those stories, or how much outside information had been released by then. Hmm… Anyway, there's something pretty interesting I can tell you about "information."
Have you ever thought about how the amount of information you had about all this before opening this save file, the order in which you encountered it, and your own subjective interpretation of it all can dramatically affect "the reality you perceive"?
That might sound a little abstract, so let me give you a couple of simpler examples.

For instance, when Exe first joined the Bureau, people in other departments were scared of him and kept their distance because of the look on his face. They immediately labeled him hard to get along with and started gossiping, each trying to avoid being the first to deal with him. So I selectively edited his full reason for joining, leaving out the context, and spread the message that he was "working to see that the criminal who killed his close friend was punished."
Think about it. When most people hear that, they naturally assume it means "he's working to secure the killer's apprehension," right? So they mistake him for someone who's cold on the outside but warm inside, with a strong sense of justice—even though they don't know him at all. Once I'd changed their impression of him, people in the other departments stopped making so many negative comments. Their attitudes improved, and they became much more willing to put up with his little lapses in social grace.
There wasn't even 0.01% of a lie in it, you know. They simply didn't guess what the sentence really meant.
It really does save a lot of unnecessary effort. Even Exe picked up the trick and started using it himself, grumbling all the while~ Now you know.

Here's another example. Do you have a sense of how the order in which you receive information can affect things? Let's say you encounter it in this order: first you get to know "this me," then you see what little "Y" looks like.
Without any further explanation, wouldn't you be more inclined to assume that "little 'Y' is me as a child" rather than "I'm using the likeness of little 'Y'"? After all, "this image is me" has already taken hold in your mind.
If simply switching the order can have that kind of effect, just imagine the potential of using more advanced, more precise methods.
If you can grasp even a little of that power, perhaps you'll understand how information tech can be used as a weapon to kill someone who once existed—or as a forbidden spell that creates life from nothing, making someone who never existed real.

After all the information you've received along the way, you probably have some thoughts of your own by now.
But even those thoughts might be the result of carefully crafting, adjusting, and controlling the information you've been given to steer them in another direction.
—Even so, do you still believe in "the reality you perceive"?

skills.name: Instant Glitch
skills.desc: Kerinduan akan balasan yang segera. Koneksi Elyms memiliki beberapa tingkat Connection Strength. Saat berada di tingkat Weak Connection, ia mengendalikan Dreamworn Terminal untuk melancarkan hingga lima serangan beruntun, memberikan Cosmos DMG. Setelah melakukan hit terakhir Instant Glitch, Elyms bisa langsung mengaktifkan Intermittent Existence untuk waktu singkat.

skills.name: Crosstalk
skills.desc: Penyesalan yang tak bisa dipudarkan waktu. Saat berada di tingkat Medium Connection atau Strong Connection, ia mengendalikan Dreamworn Terminal untuk melancarkan hingga tiga serangan beruntun, memberikan Cosmos DMG. Setelah Elyms melakukan hit terakhir Crosstalk saat Medium Connection atau Strong Connection, Goodbye to You bisa langsung diaktifkan dalam waktu terbatas.

skills.name: Interference
skills.desc: Masih agak buram… Tahan Basic Attack saat Instant Glitch di tingkat Weak Connection untuk memicu Interference, memberikan Cosmos DMG.

skills.name: Memory Anchor
skills.desc: Ayo… mengingatnya sekali lagi… Tekan Aim di tingkat Connection Strength mana pun untuk menggunakan Memory Anchor, memberikan Cosmos DMG.

skills.name: Falling Dream
skills.desc: Terjatuh dalam mimpi sekali lagi. Tekan Basic Attack saat di udara untuk menukik, memberikan 1 hit Cosmos DMG ke area saat mendarat. DMG meningkat berdasarkan ketinggian jatuh, hingga 100%.

skills.name: Okay! Shake on It!
skills.desc: Tos! Tos tinju! Sahabat selamanya! Aktif saat menekan Basic Attack setelah melakukan Critical Dodge, memberikan Cosmos DMG.

skills.name: The Ones Who Left
skills.desc: Seperti seseorang yang belum tiba. Mengendalikan Dreamworn Terminal, memberikan Cosmos DMG ke target dalam area. Setelah menggunakan skill ini saat Weak Connection, Elyms bisa langsung menggunakan Intermittent Existence dalam waktu terbatas.

skills.name: Intermittent Existence
skills.desc: Kontinuitas adalah masa lalu yang terus mendesak maju, perlahan mengikis masa depan. Memberikan Cosmos DMG ke target dalam area. Setelah menggunakan Intermittent Existence saat Weak Connection, Connection Strength-nya naik dari Weak Connection menjadi Medium Connection. Do You Get Deja Vu otomatis berganti antara bentuk area dan target tunggal sesuai jumlah target dalam jangkauan. Mendapat Optical Illusion untuk waktu terbatas saat Connection Strength-nya naik dari Weak Connection menjadi Medium Connection.

skills.name: Goodbye to You
skills.desc: Dunia yang tak dikenal adalah fatamorgana pertengahan musim panas, bahkan kamu pun bayangan yang jauh. Setelah melakukan hit terakhir Crosstalk saat Medium Connection atau Strong Connection, Elyms bisa langsung mengaktifkan Goodbye to You untuk waktu singkat. Memberikan Cosmos DMG ke target dalam area. Saat digunakan, menghabiskan semua stack Optical Illusion yang ada dan meningkatkan DMG Ratio skill ini sesuai jumlah yang dihabiskan. Setelah digunakan, Connection Strength-nya naik menjadi Strong Connection jika sedang dalam Medium Connection. Otomatis memindai target di sekitar dan mengganti Ultimate-nya antara bentuk area dan target tunggal sesuai jumlah yang terdeteksi.

skills.name: I'm Here
skills.desc: Online! Mengendalikan Dreamworn Terminal, memberikan Cosmos DMG. Setelah menggunakan I'm Here saat ia aktif, status Weak Connection-nya naik menjadi Medium Connection. Memeriksa jumlah target dalam jangkauan tertentu dan otomatis mengganti Do You Get Deja Vu antara bentuk target tunggal dan area. Mendapat Optical Illusion untuk waktu terbatas saat Weak Connection naik menjadi Medium Connection.
skills.quote: "Kamu masih ingat aku? Aku sudah di sini sejak awal."

skills.name: Relay Node
skills.desc: Charge Enhancement: Setiap kali karakter aktif mendapat Ultimate Energy, Cosmos DMG seluruh tim meningkat 3,75% selama 30 detik, hingga 8 stack. Durasi diatur ulang saat terpicu lagi. Remora Enhancement: Setiap kali rekan menerapkan Remora, Elyms akan menerapkan ulang Remora pada target yang sama setelah 7,5 detik. Terpicu paling banyak sekali setiap 7 detik. Remora yang diterapkan dengan cara ini tidak bisa memicu efek ini lagi.
skills.quote: "Sinyalnya terlalu lemah! Biar kunaikkan dayanya!"

skills.name: Pity System
skills.desc: Meningkatkan Crit DMG-nya sebesar 10%.
skills.quote: Tentu saja kita harus dalam kondisi prima sebelum pertarungan besar!

skills.name: You There?
skills.desc: Saat Elyms sedang diam, ada kemungkinan memicu "You There?", membuatnya menyapamu dan memberikan hadiah kecil yang sudah ia siapkan. Hanya satu per hari!
skills.quote: Kamu pergi ke mana?

awakening.name: 404: Island Out of Reach
awakening.desc: Untuk setiap 1 stack Optical Illusion yang dihabiskan sebelum menggunakan Do You Get Deja Vu, Crit DMG seluruh tim meningkat 10% selama 20 detik. Saat terpicu lagi, jumlah stack Optical Illusion yang terhitung direset dan efek serta durasi buff diperbarui.

awakening.name: 200: Nodes Connected
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan DMG Ratio Do You Get Deja Vu sebesar 30%. Saat menggunakan Goodbye to You, DMG-nya mengabaikan 5% DEF target untuk setiap 1 stack Optical Illusion yang dihabiskan.

awakening.name: 504: Gateway Timeout
awakening.desc: Memberikan 3 stack Optical Illusion saat Connection Strength naik dari Medium Connection menjadi Strong Connection. Optical Illusion bisa ditumpuk hingga 4 stack.

awakening.name: 302: Wish Redirected
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan Crit DMG seluruh tim sebesar 20% selama Elyms ada di dalam tim dan masih hidup.

awakening.name: 304: Nothing Has Changed
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan DMG Ratio The Ones Who Left sebesar 100%. Cycle Energy Elyms diatur menjadi 100 saat memasuki pertarungan. Cooldown: 30 detik. Hanya terpicu sekali per pertarungan.

awakening.name: 301: Moved Permanently
awakening.desc: Untuk setiap 1 stack Optical Illusion yang dihabiskan sebelum menggunakan Do You Get Deja Vu, Follow-up Attack DMG Elyms meningkat 25% selama 20 detik. Saat terpicu lagi, jumlah stack Optical Illusion yang terhitung direset dan efek serta durasi buff diperbarui.

awakening.name: For Auld Lang Syne, My Dear
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan level skill Basic Attack, Redirect Skill, dan Ultimate Elyms sebesar 1. Setelah menggunakan I'm Here atau Intermittent Existence saat Weak Connection, Connection Strength langsung naik menjadi Strong Connection. Memicu efek kenaikan dari Weak Connection ke Medium Connection, lalu efek kenaikan dari Medium Connection ke Strong Connection. Elyms bisa langsung menggunakan Goodbye to You saat Connection Strength naik menjadi Strong Connection.

awakening.name: Until Next Time, New Friend
awakening.desc: Selama Elyms masih hidup dan ada di dalam tim, DMG semua anggota tim mengabaikan 12% All Resistance target. Jika Goodbye to You menghabiskan Optical Illusion, hit terakhirnya memberikan 1 hit Cosmos DMG tambahan saat mengenai target. Pada level Counting Electric Sheep saat ini, DMG Ratio hit tambahan ini adalah {0}% per stack Optical Illusion yang dihabiskan.

name: Exe
title: Captain of ETD-6
desc:
"Hantu Bertudung Lantai 17" dulu adalah legenda urban kecil… di dalam Biro?
Katanya ada sosok suram dan aneh dengan wajah datar yang mengerikan serta aura mengancam yang menghuni sebuah ruangan di lantai itu. Ia selalu sibuk dan hampir tak pernah keluar… Kalau kamu lembur lalu membuka pintu lift dan mendapati sesuatu melayang di lorong, kemungkinan besar kamu akan menjerit ketakutan—
"Maaf. Berkas laporan insiden akan dikirim ke desktop-mu dalam tiga menit."
Percayalah, ia benar-benar tidak keberatan. Sedikit pun tidak.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Brute-Force Hacking
skills.desc: Restore. Pendekatan langsung lebih efisien. Memerintahkan Hand of Y untuk melancarkan hingga 5 serangan beruntun, memberikan Chaos DMG. Hit terakhir bisa menghabiskan 10 Frame untuk menghasilkan 1 Digital Echo.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Vertical Breach
skills.desc: Akses root diberikan. Penerobosan vertikal dimulai. Tekan Basic Attack saat di udara untuk menukik, memberikan 1 hit Chaos DMG saat mendarat. DMG meningkat berdasarkan ketinggian jatuh, hingga 100%.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Network Penetration
skills.desc: Serang. Terdeteksi beberapa lapis pertahanan. Speedrun. Tahan Basic Attack saat Special Combat Arts untuk memicu Network Penetration, memberikan Chaos DMG. Selama Shader Compile, Network Penetration mengincar musuh non-Boss dengan HP terendah dan mengeksekusinya jika HP-nya di bawah 15%, sekaligus memperpanjang Shader Compile selama X detik.

skills.name: Critical Riposte: Zero-Latency Response
skills.desc: Invincibility frame. Jendela waktu pas. Eksekusi sempurna. Skor tercatat. Aktif saat menggunakan Brute-Force Hacking setelah Critical Dodge. Memerintahkan Hand of Y untuk memberikan 1 hit Chaos DMG dan mengurangi Break target dengan jumlah tambahan. Mendapat Frame dan bisa menghabiskan 10 Frame untuk menghasilkan 1 Digital Echo.

skills.name: Data Exfiltration
skills.desc: Sesi localhost terhubung. Firewall berhasil ditembus. Memindai target… Target dihentikan. Mengalihkan… Memerintahkan Hand of Y untuk memberikan beberapa hit Chaos DMG dan menghasilkan hingga 5 Digital Echo berdasarkan jumlah Frame Exe saat ini.
skills.quote: "—Mulai! Speedrun! Timer dimulai sekarang! —… ERROR: The system cannot find the file specified."

skills.name: Mesh Collision
skills.desc: Error: Target address is null. // Keluar dari markas rahasia dan kembali ke kenyataan. return NULL Merekonstruksi kenyataan secara digital dan masuk ke Shader Compile, memerintahkan Hand of Y melancarkan beberapa serangan yang memberikan Chaos DMG masif ke target dalam jangkauan. Menghasilkan beberapa Digital Echo berdasarkan jumlah Frame saat ini. Shader Compile bertahan X detik. Selama aktif, serangan Exe apa pun bisa menghabiskan Frame untuk menghasilkan Digital Echo.
skills.quote: Koneksi ke ■■■ terputus. Menyambungkan ulang… Waktu penyambungan ulang habis. Coba lagi?

skills.name: Remote Control
skills.desc: Exe mengaktifkan Remote Control, mengarahkan aliran data untuk mengikat target. Memicu lonjakan data saat masuk ke medan, memberikan 1 hit Chaos DMG. Bisa menghabiskan 10 Frame untuk menghasilkan 1 Digital Echo.
skills.quote: "Pengambilalihan akses selesai. Sisanya biar aku yang tangani."

skills.name: Extra Score
skills.desc: Nova Enhancement: Jika Rating Exe di bawah SS saat ia memicu Nova, Rating-nya langsung naik menjadi SS.
skills.quote: "Sinergi terdeteksi. Efisiensi meningkat. Skor tambahan tercatat."

skills.name: Burst Overclock
skills.desc:
Mengurangi cooldown Redirect Skill Exe sebesar X detik setiap kali serangan Digital Echo memberikan DMG. Tidak terpicu jika sisa cooldown di bawah X detik.
Setiap kali summon milik rekan memberikan DMG, Exe mendapat satu stack DMG Bonus X%. Setiap summon bisa memberikan hingga X stack, dengan batas total X stack. Buff bertahan sampai pertarungan berakhir.
skills.quote: "RAM, CPU, voltase… Overclock manual selesai. Ayo selesaikan dengan cepat."

skills.name: Quantization Algorithm
skills.desc:
Frame: Selalu ada ruang untuk bekerja lebih cepat.
Mendapat Frame dengan mendaratkan serangan dan memanfaatkan celah singkat.
Rating: Pertarungan hanyalah sekumpulan angka lain untuk diolah.
Melacak performa bertarung melalui sistem Rating agar bisa bekerja lebih efisien.
Rating naik dengan mendaratkan serangan, menggunakan Redirect Skill, Ultimate, atau Support Skill, maupun memicu Critical Dodge, Critical Riposte, atau Parry Attack.
Mendapat Rating setiap kali rekan memicu Esper Cycle.
Terdapat lima tingkat Rating: B, A, S, SS, dan SSS. Naik ke tingkat berikutnya saat pengukur Rating penuh. Kecepatan pengumpulan Frame meningkat di tingkat yang lebih tinggi.
Rating perlahan menurun saat berhenti bertambah, dan turun drastis saat Exe terkena serangan.
skills.quote: "Hardware ditingkatkan. Alur kerja dioptimalkan. Performa keseluruhan meningkat. Test case diperbarui. Uji kelayakan dimulai. Tujuan tidak berubah."

name: Fadia
title: ETD-4, Member
desc:
"Kira-kira hari ini kita bakal ketemu Nona Fadia, nggak?"
"Mimpi saja. Mereka tidak akan mengirim agen ETD cuma untuk Anomali Kelas II."
"F-Fadia… Nona Fadia…?!"
"Berhenti terobsesi dan ayo selesaikan—Nona Fadia!"
…
"Hari itu, Nona Fadia muncul di hadapanku bagaikan penyelamat."
Surat cinta seperti ini berdatangan ke kantor ETD-4 bagai kepingan salju, dan sang "penyelamat" sendiri menganggapnya cukup menghibur. Ia sering memakainya sebagai bacaan untuk mengisi waktu di tempat kerja.

profile.intro: Anggota ETD yang berbahaya sekaligus memikat, cerminan standar rekrutmen sang direktur yang sulit ditebak.
profile.quote: Mau menikmatinya sedikit lebih lama?

stories.text:
One of the Bureau of Anomaly Control's ETD-4 members, and once a criminal.
As for what crime got her thrown onto the legendary Ghroth Island… nothing too serious. It was just an innocent little gesture that put some people to sleep forever.
"Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead back to the black hole of nothingness."
Twirling her hair around her finger, she smiled with sparkling eyes.
"I simply followed their wishes, sending those party people to the paradise they'd been craving their whole lives."

As a pardoned prisoner, she isn't treated any differently than any other Squad 4 member.
Except by that dog-faced guy with calm but wary eyes. Maybe because a few months ago they were escort officer and wanted criminal?
Well, overall, she thinks her new job is pretty good. Fighting to her heart's content, letting danger excite her mind, letting pain make her body tremble… violence comes from life's excess. How could anyone not be addicted to tasting it?
She doesn't know why that strange woman brought her back from the island, but whatever. She had nowhere else to go anyway. The place where she once knelt and prayed devoutly, entrusting her faith, has long been sealed off. Anyone who sees that ruined wasteland would laugh! Only a pair of familiar silver eyes still gaze at her, merciful, generous, full of desire… she can feel it.

"Go raise some hell, Fadia. I'm sure you'll find something interesting."
A pretender, a dog, and a brat?
Fadia narrowed her eyes.
Well then… let's find that "something interesting."

stories.title: Lirnia
stories.text:
Fadia Lirnia was the only daughter of a political family, a precocious rich girl, a bird caged behind golden bars.
From birth, the first thing she learned under everyone's watchful eyes was to hide her desires.
Until her parents, family, everything was destroyed in that unconscious rampage… She was no longer a Lirnia, and didn't need to be.
So… she gave herself a new name: Fadia DD. Desire and Death.

stories.title: Spiral Path
stories.text:
Endless rebirth and reincarnation all lead to the black hole of nothingness.
Life follows a spiral path, perfectly balanced, circling inward ring by ring, until it finally reaches… the ancient gods' paradise?
Shh. Good child, don't think too hard about it.

stories.title: Pain Addiction
stories.text:
Fadia taught herself to manipulate pain as easily as dealing with those money and power-obsessed fools.
She scratches herself, then spreads the pain throughout her body, seeking some kind of balance… the force controlled just right. In this, she has found an addictive calm.
Most people lack the ability to connect emotionally, throwing themselves into things that are easy to focus on and get addicted to. Alternating between extreme pain and pleasure… that's the secret that makes it impossible to stop.
She pities those people, just like she pities herself.
"Poor children, desire is the only thing they can rely on. Go ahead, vent, cry, succumb. Take what you desire, like babies craving their mother's milk."

stories.title: Desire
stories.text:
Human survival is contradictory. For example: taboo and transgression, reproduction and death, murder and sacrifice, sacred and profane.
In this chaotic, vulgar materialist world, only lust accepts everything about people. It embraces all their selfless, ugly, stupid, joyful faces.
Take her hand, embrace her.
Feel what grateful devotion hides behind that meaningless proud facade…
Feel how the endless, itching desire writhes within that devotion.

stories.title: Robin
stories.text:
A robin, silently staring into the distance.
The twelve-year-old girl, mesmerized by the orange-red feathers on the bird's chest, followed the fork in the path and straying off course for the first time.
Later, she saw it again in her painful, hazy consciousness.
Struggling, reaching forward with such painstaking effort…
If only she could touch but a single feather tip…
A robin, silently staring into the distance.

skills.name: Wordless Rejection

name: Hathor
title: Sterry Express Staff

profile.intro: Kurir efisien yang senang menyusun jadwal tugas yang menyeluruh lalu menjalankannya dengan disiplin sampai tuntas.
profile.quote: Sedang mengantar paket. Tinggalkan pesan.

stories.text:
After a busy day, Hathor returned to Sterry. The chatter and cheer inside was somewhat inviting. The Mentor warmly introduced two new members of Sterry: Haniel and Illica. Hathor didn't have any particular thoughts about their arrival and simply nodded in acknowledgment. Following the Mentor's arrangements was something she was used to. If Hathor were to recall her feelings from meeting with Haniel and Illica, she'd probably say: Very energetic, great couriers.

However, while interacting with them over the following few days, Hathor gradually realized that the relationships between the five of them weren't as smooth as expected. The Mentor and Jenson, who were familiar with her, could sense her true thoughts from her expressions and actions even when she said nothing, and knew she wasn't intentionally cold. The two new members didn't seem to understand, though. Perhaps due to her icy exterior, they always showed some instinctive wariness, completely different from how lively they were when facing the Mentor. Just as Hathor was repeatedly pondering how to explain to them that she simply wasn't good at socializing, a conversation with the Mentor changed everything. She was given a unique commission: spend time with Haniel and Illica, and understand the lives of modern youngsters. This was a task with a clear directive, so she didn't hesitate.

However, when actually facing the two, taking the initiative to speak proved much more difficult than expected. Hathor had mentally rehearsed scenarios for initial conversations many times and had even prepared several backup plans for dealing with awkward silences. So, during a rare chat session, she tentatively asked about their daily hobbies. The following responses completely deviated from her expectations:
"Of course it's watching the greatest manga of this century, 'Gen Z'!"
"Buying merch, going to events, analyzing the lore with fellow fans on Bagel, conventions, live events, and wotagei!"
"Seasonal anime previews, fan arts, weekly new episodes… we never miss a single one!"
Faced with Haniel's enthusiastic string of recommendations, Hathor showed visible confusion: What is wotagei? What is an "anime"?
Just as Hathor was about to interrupt and give her brain some time to process, she caught sight of Illica, who was eagerly waiting with excitement to join the conversation. She fell silent for a moment and held herself back from speaking. If they'd really like to talk about it… then listening for a while longer wouldn't hurt.

stories.title: High-Efficiency Delivery Station
stories.text:
In Sterry's early days, there were only three people. Though few in number, they had clear divisions of labor. The Mentor, well-versed in human weaknesses, frequently moved in social circles, while Jenson, with his proper speech and meticulous attention to protocol and rules, could break through negotiation deadlocks with just a few words, making him better suited for business cooperation discussions. However, from beginning to end, Hathor always maintained some reservations toward Jenson. Her sharp instincts for danger, honed through long training, whispered warnings that this man wasn't as rule-abiding as he appeared, though the Mentor's good working relationship with him indicated that Jenson could currently be trusted. As for the heavy responsibility of package delivery, it naturally fell to Hathor, who joined last.
Sterry's Elite Courier, the tough biker chick of few words, first choice for urgent delivery quests. Regular items, fragile goods, anomaly packages—all reached their destinations accurately, safely, and intact to the roar of her motorcycle. Some statistics claimed that her single-day record was 200 regular deliveries and 11 anomaly containers, all completed while assisting as an Anomaly Hunter contain two Class III anomalies. She was truly a tireless delivery machine: cold, ruthless, efficient.
Hathor herself hadn't noticed that such a pace was too demanding and had gone on too long. It wasn't until she returned one day to the shop, seeing her Mentor smiling and introducing Sterry's new members, that Hathor truly realized how exhuasted from work she was.

stories.title: Welcome Gift
stories.text:
Regalia's motorcycle key is crafted with a streamlined metal casing and delicately polished edges. The key's teeth are slightly worn, bright traces left behind from years of starting up. Such wear marks are only left when the holder is able to move with precision, cleanly, and without excess force. Hundreds, thousands of identical motions are required to achieve such perfect balance.
When alone, Hathor sometimes turns the key once. The turn is always accompanied by a soft click. She has never liked unnecessary noise, yet this sound is one she's never tried to eliminate. It was a calm yet restless night when a welcome gift was silently handed to her through her Mentor's quiet kindness—which later became a habit rooted deep in her heart.
What truly captivated her came later, when the engine sets the rhythm, marking missions received and quests completed.

stories.title: Elite Courier's Delivery Advice
stories.text:
"Heavy rainfall ahead with flooding of unknown depth. In situations like this, it's best to take a detour and avoid the risk."
"Hethereau is in the middle of rush hour traffic, so there's a high probability of congestion at the next intersection. Fortunately, the target isn't far, so switching to delivery on foot would be more efficient."
"When the road surface is rough, I recommend switching to non-slip tires. When passing through gravel, you need to adjust your center of gravity promptly to maintain stability."
"Night deliveries require constant vigilance, so blind spots must be checked repeatedly. Only proceed once safety is confirmed."

stories.title: "Diving into an Anime World"
stories.text:
To master anime culture, Hathor approached it with the spirit of tackling a difficult challenge: learning from Haniel and diving into "Gen Z."
Unlike the typical anime-watcher, Hathor wasn't a fantasy-type viewer who would arrange figurines and acrylic stands in magic circle formations, press "summon" on the latest Cubox Technologies tablet, then chant incantations to bless the spirit of binge-watching 24 episodes straight (none of which Haniel did).
Instead, during planned time periods, she pulled out a 1,000-page notebook to record various questions that arose while watching, and after finishing each episode, she wrote a review analyzing plot highlights, viewer comment dynamics, character relationships, and more. She never skipped episodes or watched in double speed, and she categorized and filed the personal styles of the main creative team's directors, scriptwriters, and animation staff.
After several days of study, during chats with Haniel, Hathor could accurately state which episode each character appeared in and how people on the internet reacted to the scene. When Haniel asked how she did this, Hathor explained what she meant by "diving into an anime." When Haniel seemed shocked, Hathor quietly wondered to herself: Perhaps I should've tried harder…?

stories.title: Non-Mission
stories.text:
One day after finishing her delivery quests, Hathor was riding her motorcycle as usual, speeding away down the road. Perhaps because she'd been watching too much anime lately, the massive billboard advertisement for "Gen Z" unusually caught Hathor's attention. The limited venue merchandise shown in the promotional image was a term Hathor had been hearing frequently recently, and it looked familiar. The items could only be purchased through limited offline channels, like exclusive conventions, shops, or cafes. As it happened, there was a shop nearby that Haniel had been talking about for ages, and somehow, Hathor felt like trying her luck.
The phrase "trying her luck" shouldn't appear in the vocabulary of someone accustomed to precision operations. Since getting into anime culture, Hathor had gradually begun accepting things in life that carried "randomness": the randomness of gacha pulls, daily fragmented discussions about new anime with her two fellow fans, the randomness of new terms popping up unexpectedly, the "pseudo-randomness" of whether limited venue merchandise could be obtained, and so on…
Today also brought a random event: the spontaneous decision to detour to a limited merchandise shop after finishing deliveries. Next she would "try her luck" on limited goods, and then give an unexpected gift to the two little owls… Hathor habitually kept herself wound tight, perhaps due to muscle memory from early high-intensity deliveries, or the professional discipline of strictly following plans, plus the careful caution she'd always maintained toward her Esper after losing control.
But since she'd begun learning about "modern youngster life" from those two, something called "randomness" had started taking root in her body. Like noticing the billboard advertisement today, like suddenly detouring to a merchandise shop, like putting a gift that wasn't on her quest list into her pouch. She had never so clearly realized that she had been wound too tight for too long, so long that she'd forgotten she actually lived in a city full of human warmth and life.

stories.text:
The most unreliable adult (whose job, according to Sakiri, is to get completely wasted every day), the mysterious boss that Nanally admires, and the enigmatic boss for everyone else in Eibon.
Right now, she's examining a frog-shaped cosmetic device.

"What excellent taste you have, dear customer! You picked the most valuable treasure from my entire collection straight away! Surely you've heard the legend of the 'Angel's Kiss'? That's right! The holy grail of skincare that makes you radiant and supple, the 'Pale Sacred Dew' long-sought after by elite nobles for centuries, is now resting in your very hands! If it weren't for… my urgent need for funds, forcing me to part with this treasure… Well, 50,000 Fons! And this treasure could be yours!"
Hotori gave a dramatic gesture in a bold stance, suggesting she won't budge on the price. The merchant, who was speaking in flattering tones, made a pained expression and hesitated.
"Customer, you really don't hold back! In that case, 5,000 Fons. Let's be friends!"

Whenever she thinks she's getting a bargain, or whenever she believes she's found some treasure, she can never hide the smile appearing on her face as she slams the table and shouts "Deal!"
Perhaps within half a day she'll discover she's been scammed, then become furious and drown her sorrows in alcohol.
Or perhaps when she receives the bill at the end of the month, she'll furrow her brow with bitter regret.

But at least the moment of owning a brand new "treasure" is undoubtedly worth celebrating.
"As for the future… well, we'll deal with that when the future comes!"

"'All-you-can-drink' means you pay a fixed price based on the number of people in your group, and until you leave and settle the bill, you can take unlimited beverages from the drink area… that's what their menu says."
"Including alcohol? That's pretty generous! Everyone should really enjoy themselves today, and you kids better go grab the most expensive juice they have!"
"…Restaurants definitely lose money when they run into shameless customers like Hotori who can really hold their liquor, right?"
Of course, this business model has countermeasures for dealing with customers who go overboard: besides the inventory limits for each type of beverage, there's also the time restriction… but when it comes to Hotori, that just happens to not be a problem.
However, based on what happened later, when Hotori kept ordering table after table of appetizers to maximize the value of the all-you-can-drink deal… This rare dining-out experience still ended up with expenses far exceeding the budget.

stories.title: Live for Today
stories.text:
There are currently no late-night chat sessions happening between antiques in Eibon… probably. After all, not many of them can talk. This doesn't stop the Temporal Globe from rolling around when bored, surveying the other items in the shop and letting its imagination run wild.
(Hey, newcomer, where are you from?)
(I used to sleep in a dirty street until someone took a liking to me and bought me. The cost of my freedom was 998 Fons. Does that put me at the bottom of the hierarchy in this shop?)
(There are plenty who don't even know their own worth. Like me, I stayed in a dark, cramped place for ages and ages… so long that the little crack I had grew bigger and successfully merged with the original carved patterns… until… light came in. That woman appeared, gently lifted me out, and smiled.)
(Was it one of those scheming, triumphant smirks?)
(No. It was a completely confident smile, like she was certain I'd be there. But for some reason, that smile made her seem somewhat… regretful?)
(Haha, I bet she dusted off the dirt only to discover you weren't in as good condition as she imagined!)
The discussion that never happened and never will happen grows more animated, accompanied by the blinking sounds of the Temporal Globe. The Mirror of Anam simply reflects peacefully, capturing all the stillness and the passage of time across its surface.

stories.title: Fated Old Treasures
stories.text:
An exquisite pocket watch crafted with cloisonné enamel technique.
Above the ghost orchid pattern, an orange-red gemstone is set, like eyes that have grown gentle after fading through long years… Yet the watch face still retains bright and delicate colors, showing no signs of age.
It's neither an Anomaly nor an Esper creation. Though beautifully crafted, it's truly just an ordinary pocket watch without any special powers.
Hotori never discusses its actual value. Perhaps it's some precious treasure she keeps hidden away? Something she wouldn't sell for money unless Eibon was on the verge of bankruptcy… her ultimate backup insurance, maybe?

stories.title: Enamel Pocket Watch
stories.text:
The Tsukinoki family's courtyard pairs perfectly with fallen snow. The snow gives it an added sense of historical elegance, like covering displayed antiques with a blanket of dust—except this dust is pure white and pristine.
Unfortunately, year after year, such scenery passes by in the blink of an eye. Hotori has always felt this way.
Even at a young age, she was already deeply melancholic about the changing seasons and passing years. This was because she feared that the ever-changing outside world would bring unwanted changes to this reclusive family. How wonderful it would be if everything could freeze like a still life at its most perfect moment.
"The best time to appreciate snow is when it's melting. For that… you need to be in motion, don't you?"
Many years later, when she truly could make snowy scenes stand still, one early spring she encountered—not by chance—an old guest who had once stayed at their family estate for a time. Now an elderly man in his twilight years, he took a sip from his wine cup after every sentence during their casual conversation.
Hotori realized this would be their final meeting. She poured the wine and waited with rare solemnity to hear his next heartfelt words.
"What's most precious isn't what remains unchanged and eternal. It's the things that break… the things that are breaking right now."

stories.title: Best Time for Snow Viewing
stories.text:
"The most precious things are those that are breaking," isn't that right?
"Then why not be as greedy as possible? Go and gather more precious treasures into your embrace."
"Just like in that numbing bitter cold… I will reclaim the warmth of my own blood."
This is what she thought.
At the same time, she would think this countless times in the days to come. Inevitably.
She put away her pocket watch, stood up, and moved forward with joy.

name: Iroi
title: Member of CSU-2
desc:
Bagi yang pertama kali bertemu dengannya, ia hangat dan ramah, mudah dipercaya, dan mudah didekati.
Semua tindakannya yang disengaja sesuai sempurna dengan apa yang orang harapkan dari seorang "gadis normal".
Semuanya baik-baik saja. Ini berhasil.

profile.intro: Oneiroi adalah anak penurut yang memenuhi semua kriteria.
profile.quote: Hiduplah dengan baik
profile.impression:
Bagi yang pertama kali bertemu dengannya, ia hangat dan ramah, mudah dipercaya, dan mudah didekati.
Semua tindakannya yang disengaja sesuai sempurna dengan apa yang orang harapkan dari seorang "gadis normal".
Semuanya baik-baik saja. Ini berhasil.

stories.text:
"Iroi called in sick again? Her paid time off and sick days ran out ages ago. Feels like her paycheck's been getting docked."
"She doesn't seem to care about her paycheck… She once said she wouldn't mind paying to work. It didn't sound like she was joking about it."
"That's so nice. She works pretty hard. I didn't know she was just working to experience the world…"

Iroi has been prone to sickness since childhood. She couldn't attend regular schools. Luckily, her family was well-off, so she had a private tutor all the time, and she became as educated as someone who has done general university coursework.
After finishing her studies, her parents wanted her to integrate into society, but her health couldn't handle the demands of a regular job. Iroi wanted to work at a social welfare organization, so her parents sent her to the Sunward, an anomaly charity house, to volunteer, where she also helped with the simpler anomaly intake work.
Iroi's current personality is deeply shaped by the vibes of the charity house. Before going there, she hadn't had much contact with others. Her tutor and butler were cold and rigid, always overly cautious, while her parents doted on her too much. Iroi understood that not all human beings were like them, so she instinctively chose to blend in with "everyone else."
Life on the island wasn't exactly smooth sailing. Things were a lot tougher than they were back home. Nevertheless, Iroi enjoyed that kind of environment much more, because she felt more alive.
During the Teehee Bear incident at the charity house, Iroi the volunteer provided significant help to the Bureau, and the Bureau staff took notice of this talented Esper. At the same time, Iroi found herself drawn to the Bureau's work. They came to an agreement and Iroi joined the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Given her strong control over her powers, she was recommended to join CSU-2.
Life has a way of moving on.

stories.title: Unbroken Dream
stories.text:
For most people, dreams are unstable and ephemeral. Iroi's Esper Ability stabalizes dreams, making them constants that do not cease to exist when impacted by external factors.
Iroi can send her dreams into the consciousness of other living beings. The number of beings she can affect at the same time varies, depending on the targets' mental strengths. If the target's mental strength is too high, she may not be able to break in at all. She also can't affect beings without sentience.

Two gates exist at the entrance of Iroi's dream world, a Horned Gate and an Ivory Gate. Sometimes she conceals one of them when necessary.
If one enters the Ivory Gate, they are forced to experience a long and bizarre dream of creatures fighting and devouring each other. No one knows why this is the case.
If one enters the Horned Gate, they reach Iroi's true dream world and can have a nice dream. The real Iroi is hiding somewhere in the corner of this world.

In other words, the "Iroi" people see on the outside is not her true self.
The Iroi people see is nothing but an illusion created by her powers. The external Iroi, after taking over the original, is in essence a non-human consciousness that mimics human beings.
Don't be afraid. The external Iroi has posed as a human for about twenty years. She's not that different from a genuine human. She won't bite.
No need to panic.

stories.title: In CSU-2
stories.text:
The Bureau of Anomaly Control and the charity house have entirely different vibes. Still, Iroi was able to get used to the different pace, and she got along with her new teammates, Mint and Shinku.
While Shinku's powers could drive her berserk, Iroi can use her powers to calm Shinku down in the dream world. As a result, Shinku frequently enters Iroi's dream world, and they got along.
However, after a certain mission, things changed. Shinku's attitude towards Iroi shifted for the worse, almost harboring animosity. Iroi didn't know what caused this change, but she responded with the same attitude. The two of them were friendly no more.
Mint noticed the awkward tension between the two. After some poking around between missions, she finally figured it out. Shinku had seen "the other Iroi" in her dream world. Shinku mistakenly assumed that the external Iroi had taken over the real one, and disgusted by what she thought was happening, she held a grudge against the external Iroi.
After that, Mint worked hard to convince Shinku and Iroi to clear up the misunderstanding. Once Shinku learned the truth about the Iroi in the dream world, she realized she assumed wrongly and apologized to Iroi.

"You saw that pitiful being in a dream and threw out everything to stand up for her—what a hotheaded dragon who doesn't think things through!"
"Arrgh, why are you still so mean after I said sorry? You… Ramtenna!"
"Okie-dokie, problem solved! Let's get along with each other like this!"

That's how Mint earned a lavish meal from Shinku and Iroi.

stories.title: Sleeping
stories.text:
Iroi's powers create a stable dream for her, but a dream needs someone to be dreaming, and that person is the real Iroi within. The dreams created by her powers belong to her. The real Iroi always remains inside the dream world, always dreaming, and thus always sleeping.
The Iroi outside doesn't need to rest. In theory, she could stay awake forever. That said, sleep is something humans need, so she still goes to bed on time, pulls up the blanket, and shuts her eyes like everyone else.
She doesn't fall asleep, but she enjoys the cozy feeling of being wrapped in soft and fluffy blankets.

stories.title: Three Kids
stories.text:
At first, Iroi's dream world was just a hazy, chaotic mess. As she grew up and experienced more of the world, three little kids, Morpheus, Icelos, and Phantasos, started trying to fill her dream world with color and life. The three kids worked together. Morpheus created passers by, Icelos created birds and beasts, and Phantasos created scenery that weren't based on living beings. Through their collective efforts, Iroi's dream world became a tiny world that rivaled reality itself.
As for when the three kids first appeared, neither Iroi remembers clearly—did they show up when her powers awakened? The real Iroi claims to have seen them since the moment she was born.
Morpheus likes to act cool and calls himself the boss, but he's actually the one who usually gets picked on. Icelos is cute and shy, but has a bit of a mischievous streak. Phantasos is a total airhead, always flying around aimlessly while blowing a little trumpet. For young Iroi, who spent so much of her time alone in hospitals and at home, they were her best friends.

"Iroi has new friends now. Is it time for us to leave?"
"No way, I don't want to leave her!"
"She's there… we're there… must not part…"

stories.title: Price
stories.text:
Iroi's health had been a serious concern as soon as she was born. Things only started to improve until her Esper Abilities awakened when she was one. Even now, she still wears a life monitor as a precaution.
The real Iroi, however, does not want to live.
Even so, her parents were determined to save her. No matter how much money it took, they kept sending her into surgery after surgery, refusing to let her go.
The thing is, when Iroi woke up in her mother's womb, still floating in water, she already knew she didn't want to be born.

Iroi's powers kept her alive. It shaped a new consciousness for her—one that took over from the Iroi who never wanted to live—and kept her going.
Her Esper Abilities may have saved her by keeping her alive, but in truth, they've been exacting a price from her all along.
The price of her powers is to live.

Neither Iroi believes they were meant to be born. Both see themselves as something that should have been weeded out by natural selection.
However—
"You're alive. That already proves you weren't supposed to be eliminated. Is that so hard to understand? There's no such thing as "should be" in this world. What's already happened cannot change. The fact that you're alive embodies more truth than any theory, isn't it?"

stories.title: First Dream
stories.text:
What makes a human human?

Before waking up, Iroi had a long, strange dream. It started in the pitch-black depths of the sea, slowly rising up, then stepping onto land, running like mad through a barren jungle just to avoid being eaten.
I heard everyone has a dream like this while they're still in the womb. You watch yourself crawl from the water onto land, slowly evolving into a human, and finally wake up naturally, right as you're being born.
But in that dream, Iroi wasn't born as a primate. Instead, she was sent on a different evolutionary path, becoming one of the Caprinae.
This should never have happened, and her human nature forced her to wake up from that dream. And so, she woke up in her mother's womb way too early.
Fetuses wake up, but Iroi's case was different. She woke up with complete consciousness. She touched around, felt the warmth around her, and caught the occasional glimpse of faint light. It was dim, warm, comfortable, with a pulse beating in rhythm with her own. So this is the "world," so this was what it felt like to be "alive."
She was taken away as her world opened up.
After living in the womb, the real world overflowed with light and empty space. It was terrifying. Her mind was shocked, and she no longer wanted to live. As a result, Iroi lost consciousness, and her body shut down. That's the beginning of her sicknesses.

At first, the Iroi created from her powers only knew that she must live.
When she was hungry or was in pain, she voiced her needs to attract attention.
Then she noticed that people made all kinds of sounds to express their thoughts. She slowly started to understand the sounds, then tried making them herself—and that, is how she learned to speak.
Just saying something out loud isn't always enough to make people believe it, so she learned all the right expressions.
Knowing what to say, to whom, and in what context, that's something she also had to pick up, however slowly…

Having grown up this way, how exactly is she any different from any authentic human being?

—Humans usually do not question whether they are humans or not. She does. That's about it.

profile.intro: Kurir Elite Sterry yang pandai bicara dan penuh teka-teki, sekaligus menjabat sebagai Acting Manager.
profile.quote: Selamat datang di Sterry Express!
profile.impression:
Di Sterry, informasi sering tiba lebih dulu daripada paketnya, dan jaringan informasi ini berjalan lancar berkat koordinasi Jiuyuan.
Ia pandai membaca orang, menyusun gambaran utuh dari petunjuk sekecil apa pun. Hanya dengan beberapa bisikan, ia bisa membuat orang lain tanpa sadar membocorkan rahasianya. Dengan kemampuan sosial kelas satu dan jaringan yang dibangun bertahun-tahun, ia sering diundang ke salon pribadi eksklusif di Hethereau. Di sana ia bergaul dengan tokoh-tokoh berpengaruh yang lebih suka menjauh dari sorotan, dan menyegel kesepakatan tepat pada saat yang pas.

stories.text:
After retiring from her previous job, Jiuyuan settled into a fairly relaxed life at Sterry.
The day-to-day tasks aren't complicated: sending and receiving packages, checking receipts, and passing around clipboards for signatures… As long as the process is clear and the staff reliable, none of the tasks pose much of a challenge. The real headaches come from commissions that can't be handled through any standard procedures: those involving intel, Anomalies, and the Anomaly Hunters who handle them. Clients with hidden agendas tapping their fingers on the counter, buyers using Anomalies as cover for covert handoffs, clients falsifying danger levels to drag Sterry into their schemes, not to mention the tangled web of factions at play… These may not seem a big deal, yet calculated troubles are far more vexing than any package delivery.

Still, Jiuyuan handles them all with ease.
One moment she's making small talk with a contact at a banquet hall, and the next she's at the scene of a target's transaction, tidying up the mess. She never breaks a sweat, and leaves only the cool scent of roses in her wake. With her intel and finesse, she has quietly woven a web across the fabric of this city. Most ripples, no matter how faint, inevitably land in it.

Though, what she excels at most is reading people.
Hathor, earnest to the point of stubbornness, is assigned to critical operations, handling high-risk Anomalies or missions where failure isn't an option.
Haniel and Illica, lively and quick on their feet, are better suited for dealing with people or coming up with a spark of brilliance when situations go sideways.
As for Manager Jenson and what he's been up to lately…
He really should find a better hiding spot for that fishing rod.

stories.title: Public Quotes
stories.text:
"Sterry… is about getting the right deliveries into the right hands." Kids who dream of saving the world tend to eat up lines like that.
"Great work." Simple, straightforward words like those make simple, straightforward kids feel praised and motivated.
"A smart person like you knows how to make the right choice." When dealing with complicated adults, a mix of pressure and persuasion, a low tone, and a certain rhythm can make them more… cooperative.
"You look a bit tired. Want to talk about it?" A gentle, caring tone makes certain people let their guard down more easily.
Of course, when handling things on behalf of the shop, no matter how many customers come through, the best line is always:
"Sterry Express, at your service!"

stories.title: Rose Collector
stories.text:
A violet-blue rose.
Its color falls somewhere between deep purple and ashen blue, and its petals curl slightly at the edges, shimmering with a cold, metallic luster in the light. It sits in a plain white porcelain vase, kept fresh in clear water, stem standing straight, clearly well-tended. Yet the petals near the base have begun to wither and gray, as if some of its life force has been quietly siphoned away, leaving it barely holding its form.

Beside the vase stand several other gifts from the past:
A dark red rose, petals brittle as paper. It was once offered by a smiling guest during a toast, though the poison in his glass nearly spilled over as their hands touched.
A gold-edged rose, petal tips singed with scorch marks. It came from a murmured ritual, its giver claiming to be a devotee, though the flames spiraled out of control the moment the prayer was spoken.
A rose faded almost to pale gray, personally presented by a client as a token of sincerity, though beneath its petals lay a web of carefully crafted lies…

Each of these flowers marks the beginning of an encounter, a testament to a confrontation. The intel, the energy, the killing intent hidden within them… she refines it all into bullets, then traces the arc of the moment they were given, and silently returns them to the ones who offered them.

stories.title: Non-Standard Answers
stories.text:
It took Jiuyuan a lot of effort to retrieve Hathor after she was taken by the Bureau for losing control of her Esper Abilities. The loss of control itself wasn't the issue. What mattered was how Hathor handled the aftermath, and this was the first lesson Jiuyuan, as Hathor's mentor, needed to teach.
From that day on, Hathor doubled her training regimen on her own. Her movements grew faster and her decisions sharper as she shed off exhaustion for stability. Her expression remained calm, but her rhythm had become erratic. Jiuyuan knew this state all too well: the more one rushes to control one's powers, the easier it becomes for the powers to control them. She didn't stop Hathor’s training, nor did she warn her about overdoing it. Some students tend to mistake reminders for warnings or interpret concern as mentors thinking they aren’t trying hard enough. Rather than have Hathor quietly use such warnings as a new benchmark to push even harder, Jiuyuan thought it was better to let her train where she could watch. By keeping an eye on things, nothing would go wrong.
But the nature of Sterry's work meant Jiuyuan couldn't have Hathor's back forever. How could she pave the way before letting go? What she hadn't expected was that the solution would find its way to her. Haniel, who had stumbled onto the scene when Hathor lost control, unexpectedly had the ability to calm her. And as luck would have it, the girl was also interested in courier work…
Things just fell into place.

Hathor's execution and combat abilities were impeccable, but interacting with others left her at a loss. When the two little owlets first arrived, Hathor faced them like someone flipping through a book with no instructions: cautious, yet clueless about where to begin. The awkwardness in the shop didn't elude Jiuyuan. In a rare move, she gave Hathor a special commission: make an effort to understand today's youth and assimilate.
Imagining the ever-methodical Hathor carrying out this commission, Jiuyuan, who was usually so adept at controlling her emotions, couldn't suppress a smile—her first one.
What Jiuyuan had always known, but Hathor had yet to realize: that stubborn, almost clumsy honesty of hers, was exactly what she needed to connect with those two little owlets.

Changes began to occur in Hathor’s daily life: popular comics started appearing on her desk, and on days off, she would go to livehouses with Haniel and Illica instead of staying alone in the training room. Occasionally, new words she'd never used before would slip into her conversations.
Though Hathor still worried about losing control, much of her tension had vanished amidst the laughter and playfulness of everyday life at Sterry. After one Esper control lesson, Jenson, who had been watching, teased, "You've been mentoring her for so long, and now she's getting more popular thanks to being 'led astray' by those two little owlets. How does that feel?"
"I thought you only cared about fishing. Seems you haven't completely lost your sense as a spy."
Hathor's tone was as flat as ever: "Would you like me to conduct another loss-of-control test right now?"
Jiuyuan glanced at Jenson, who was silently calculating the renovation costs if Hathor decided to lose control on purpose. Jiuyuan couldn't help but smile. "No need. Things are just fine the way they are."
There's no need to mold a student to fit some standard. She can find her own answer.

stories.title: A Leisurely Routine Takes Shape
stories.text:
The year-end shopping list was, as always, Jiuyuan's responsibility. But this year, when it came to what to buy, things were a little different from before. The moment Haniel and Illica, who had just recently joined, heard about the year-end shopping, they immediately insisted on adding a celebration party that wasn't part of the original plan. And so, what was once a neat and simple list turned into an outing for all five of them.
"Jiuyuan! We need flowers, balloons, spotlights… and cake!"
"And a standee!"
"…What's a standee?"
"You know, one of those poster things with your photo on it that you put by the entrance. Hathor, wanna try it?"
"That won't be necessary… Master."

"What about presents? There should at least be presents!"
"Of course, everyone gets one."
"Hehe, Jiuyuan's the best!"
"What about Jenson? Did he get us presents?"
"Today's bill is going under his name."
"Jenson's so generous!"
"Then I'm adding a few new comics!"
"And the CD I didn't get last time!"
"…Fine, get it all."

The list was checked, revised, and added to over and over again.
As the two little owlets eagerly confirmed every checkmark with Jenson, Jiuyuan stood off to the side and let out a soft sigh.
A little noisy, a little chaotic.
But in moments like these, the accounts can wait, and the plans can be pushed back a bit.
Times like this… aren't so bad.

stories.title: Codename: Nightingale
stories.text:
By that time, Jiuyuan was no longer a novice just awakening to her Esper Abilities. Yet she still stood before the final barrier of a rigid hierarchy: she had to earn a codename that was truly her own.

The trial came swiftly. It was an alley skirmish, accompanied by the kind of betrayal and sellouts that were all too common in the trade. Her squad found themselves caught in a total hunt. The value of their intel, their reputation in the circle, and the enemy's frenzied intent to silence them all drove the entire squad deep into the shadows of the alley. Supplies cut off, forces depleted, the outside world a blur, and the cover of night draped over every disadvantage. What should have been the enemy's perfect cover became the rhythm Jiuyuan knew best.
Her footsteps were near silent, yet she found every enemy with precision through the web woven of gunfire and bodies. A faint glow rippled through the dim air like water, followed by a clear, slender call. Cold and unwavering, piercing straight to the soul. Those who heard it felt their blood run cold in an instant.
Whenever that sound swept past an ear or brushed a shoulder, a flicker of rose-colored light would bloom, then condense into a slender bullet before sinking into the target's body. No explosion, no struggle. The moment it struck, it was as if all sound had been drained away, leaving only silent finality.
When the last note, like a bird's call, faded at the alley's end, the depths fell silent once more.
The surviving squad members leaned against the cold walls, watching the figure emerge from the smoke and darkness, the rhythm that had decided life and death still echoing in their ears.
"That was the only sound you could trust in the night."

Later, the codename field on the mission report was filled in with neat handwriting:
Nightingale.
She sings in the deepest dark. Her voice is the prelude to death, and the dawn for those who survive.
