profile.intro: Impianku adalah menjadi gadis SMA cantik yang menyelamatkan dunia!
profile.quote: genesectparanormaldeptace

stories.text:
Haniel. Public Bagel Account: @Haniel_SterryExpress. Private Account: @genesectparanormaldeptace. Current main alt: @fancontentmaster. The public account is for plugging Sterry Express and managing the brand image of Sterry Express—"If the money's good, we deliver anything!" (Jiuyuan's words). The private account is Haniel's main social hub: fics, art, music, cosplay sets… In the scene, she's a god-tier creator with an endless output. Her only flaw? Her posting schedule is a disaster! Her fans live in permanent agony, screaming: "It's so good, I'll take whatever crumbs I can get!" As for the alt, on days she's too lazy to post, Haniel just surfs Bagel incognito on various throwaway accounts. The second her cover is blown, she jumps ship to the next. She's sworn to defend the sacred right to consume fan content in peace.

Ever delivered a package before? Every Sterry Express courier has their own delivery ritual. For Haniel, the moment she gets the delivery slip, it's like a quest notification has dropped straight into her hands——
Today's Quest: Deliver Package (0/1)
Package Integrity: 100%
Time Left: 00:59:59
3-Star Rating:
No-Damage Delivery (0/1)
On-Time Delivery (0/1)
Service with a Smile (0/1)

When Haniel was little, she had a ton of so-called "hobbies": violin, horseback riding, chess… Just like every other kid in her circle, she went through the usual "elite education" routine. She didn't hate any of it, but that didn't mean she liked it either. It all felt like a drizzly, soggy day where the world's colors are washed out and even birds feathers get stuck together.
Haniel likes sunny days better. So, before her nightly bedtime story, little Haniel sat down with her mother for a real conversation on equal footing. She laid out what she wanted and what confused her, asking the person closest to her for help. Her mom gently stroked her hair and apologized, saying she'd failed to notice Haniel's feelings in time.
Finding your true "hobby," the thing that's really yours, is hard. Luckily, Haniel was one of the fortunate ones.

stories.title: "Gen Z" Anniversary Edition Headset
stories.text:
The path to becoming an Elite Courier isn't always smooth sailing.
During her 16th delivery quest, Haniel accidentally lost a package. Even though it was found three hours later and Owner Jiuyuan didn't blame her for anything, Haniel still felt really guilty. Not wanting to worry her family too much, Haniel acted normal at the dinner table, casually chatting about all sorts of topics she was interested in. Of course, brave Haniel wouldn't let negative feelings bother her for long. After a good night's sleep, she was back to her usual self… but before leaving the house, Haniel received a gift. The headset she had mentioned at dinner the night before was now sitting quietly by her bedroom door.
"Haniel will definitely become the best courier ever," read the note on the gift box.

stories.title: Old Journal
stories.text:
Yellowed stickers and childish handwriting… this is the secret Haniel has hidden in the deepest part of her bookshelf.
"The royal hounds are nothing but my steeds. In ten minutes, your crimes will be exposed!"
"Only those who risk everything for victory have the right to stand on the battlefield!"
"You bastards without hope or dreams, I'll keep my back straight and live on until my body is destroyed!"
"The destination doesn't matter at all, as long as I keep moving forward, as long as I don't stop…"
"My revenge… this is where the curtain truly rises."
After all, who doesn't have a notebook stuffed full of childhood memories?

stories.title: Custom Guitar Pick
stories.text:
After finishing binge-watching "Notes of the Future" at 3:43 AM, Haniel ordered a guitar while her eyes were still red from crying. This time, she would rewrite the band's ending herself.
Unfortunately, her elite education included violin, viola, and cello, but she had never been taught how to play guitar. None of that mattered though. Brave Haniel wasn't afraid of any challenge!
Picture this: After school, Haniel rides her bike alone to the park at sunset, a gentle breeze brushing the loose strands by her temples. By the fountain, the sentimental, shy girl finally finds a quiet corner where no one will notice. She takes a deep breath and pulls out a guitar she got from her father, the pick gently caressing the strings as beautiful melodies flow from the girl's fingertips. Leaves fall onto the water's surface, and when the performance ends, another girl jumps out from the nearby bushes with stars in her eyes, saying "Would you like to start a band with me?"
So Haniel sat in the park with her guitar for three whole months, with only cats as her audience… though cat audiences are pretty good too.

stories.title: Sticky Note with Chili Oil Stains
stories.text:
How to Brew the Perfect Cup of Black Tea:
Materials needed: Tea leaves (select OP-grade loose leaf, not tea bags), soft water (no mineral water), fresh pasteurized milk, a bit of white sugar, and an elegant tea set.
Steps: 1. Boil water, bring the soft water to a boil
2. Warm the pot for one minute
3. Ration the tea leaves (one teaspoon of tea leaves per cup)
4. Steep the tea leaves for three minutes
5. It's best to drink tea from ceramic cups
6. Add the milk to the cup first, then slowly pour in the tea
7. Add sugar according to personal preference
8. The best drinking temperature is between 60–65 degrees Celsius
### Remember: Milk first, then tea
A line of messy handwriting: Tea first then milk tastes good too

stories.title: Paw Bookmark
stories.text:
Haniel's books are always filled with bookmarks, each stamped with little animal paw prints. Whenever Haniel befriends small animals in the park, she makes a special bookmark for them, stamping their paws as keepsakes. These little travelers are always on the move. Who knows when they'll meet again?
There's always one slightly worn bookmark in Haniel's books. It’s stamped with a black, somewhat incomplete kitten paw print, and the markings match the black and white bookmark. Haniel never became friends with this one… the cat was far too cautious. While the other cats happily shared the snacks Haniel brought, this one would always watch quietly from a distance.
It still sleeps peacefully on the same little hillside. Haniel sometimes goes there to play guitar, even though she sounds terrible.

name: Mint

desc:
Mint percaya setiap orang punya aroma yang unik dan lebih suka memanggil orang dengan aroma yang ia cium daripada namanya. Julukan-julukannya yang nyeleneh, kepribadiannya yang energik, dan kinerjanya yang luar biasa dalam tugas penahanan membuatnya dipuji bahkan oleh senior yang paling tegas. Namun—
"Hehe, aku bakal jadi Ace CSU… Aku gagal ujian regulasi penahanan lagi…? Huwaa…"
Jelas, Mint masih butuh sedikit keberuntungan untuk meraih mimpinya.

profile.intro: Kalau ada peringkat seperti itu di Containment Unit, mungkin akulah pemegang rekor "Paling Sering Ditipu Anomali"…
profile.quote: Belum pernah gagal satu mata kuliah pun!

stories.text:
My dream is to become a CSU Ace! Player Mint, ready to go!
She probably loves field work the most among all the Containment Units members. She even loves it on scorching hot days. She can sneak a Blizzi Ice Cream during downtime, and won’t hesitate to apply for heat allowance when she gets back to the bureau.
The frequency of Mint's makeup exams at the bureau perfectly matches her field mission frequency.

Loyal user of Fluffy Tail Care Spray, she’s brave enough to try all the new scents. By try, she means sniffing them… Mint would never lick her own tail fur!
Her friendship with Nanally started when both their hands reached for the last bottle of care spray in the store! The partners at Nanally's Eibon Antique Shop are all so nice! Hotori Senpai… definitely has some stories to tell!

Ehhhhh! Found Lacrimosa Senpai again during field work! At times like this, I should definitely contact our reliable Lieutenant… User currently unavailable? Must be in a meeting. I'm doomed! Mint can't handle either Baicang Senpai or Fadia Senpai!

Ha! Another day working hard toward becoming a CSU Ace! Once I get this anomaly into Temporary Containment, I can probably clock out, right?

Sniff sniff, Lavender is here! And that unfamiliar but warm Coco scent next to her is…

stories.title: Colucci Family, Honorary Member
stories.text:
Mint is actually a member of the great Colucci family too… well, to be exact, an honorary member.
After receiving Nanally Colucci's olive branch, Mint thought long and hard about joining, with the same seriousness she puts into preparing for makeup exams.
First! Mint totally respects this genius girl!
Second! A family sounds really cool! Mint loves hanging out with friends (family-members-to-be)!
Most importantly: Mint is worst at saying no to people!
However, Mint ultimately declined Nanally's proposal, promising that as an honorary member of the family, she'd drop by Eibon from time to time.
Because… Containment Units work is super, super busy, and if Nanally suddenly called a family meeting, Mint couldn't guarantee she'd be able to rush over right away. That would make Mint a tardy family member, and she'd be breaking the family rules!
The most important thing about a family is the rules. That's just how it is.

stories.title: Kittens always grow up so fast
stories.text:
There is an inevitable pain that comes with becoming a teenager—its the most unforgettable memory of a child. Waking up in the middle of the night from an ache, growing taller with each stretch of the body…
But for Mint, this physical pain was never present.
Maybe she was too young when her growth spurts hit; she reached her current height before she was 10. Maybe her naturally carefree nature made her unusually slow to react to the changes that come with growing up. Whatever anguish that summer’s on-and-off joint pain might have brought got left behind along with her brand new, unopened summer homework.

stories.title: Tiny and Big Kid
stories.text:
An awkward age, an awkward height. She towered so much over her peers that strangers would mistake her for a high school student several years older. It wasn't too surprising that Mint, as such a "big kid," couldn't really play with her little friends.
Mint liked climbing trees to nap in the sun, a blade of grass between her teeth as she secretly watched the neighbor kids play and fight. Then, casually… or at least trying to make it look casual, she'd help get their kites unstuck from the branches.
"Tiny" suddenly appeared during one of her half-asleep moments, and Mint still remembers how embarrassing she looked tumbling out of that tree.
The young-faced little guy called out to her: "Hey, kid."

stories.title: Kitty Crossbody Bag
stories.text:
A candy-colored waist bag gifted by "Tiny," with a matching notebook inside. The pages are clean, smooth, and absolutely beautiful.
Hands in pockets, super cool "Tiny" gave Mint the childish, adorable gift before parting, stubbornly defending it as "perfect for a little brat like you."
She met someone who looked like a kid, but was actually a sharp-eyed, reliable adult working at the Bureau of Anomaly Control! Tiny and Big Kid had an unforgettable adventure that summer! Tiny helped Big Kid better control her Esper Ability! Tiny is Big Kid's most important friend! Tiny and Big Kid will meet again in the future!
Little Mint achieved her dream at summer's end: join BAC and reunite with "Tiny" (who'll be "Tiny Senpai" by then).
Like an ice-cold cola that instantly cools down a stuffy, sweltering summer… her scent awaits in the not-so-distant future.

stories.title: Taste of Everything
stories.text:
The tempting beef tallow base of Panda Hotpot… The sweet and tangy Blizzi Berrie Ice Cream… The bitter yet rich aroma of coffee poured full by Ms. Fei…
Familiar, beloved daily moments write themselves in bold strokes engraved in memory through their scents.
Relax, take a deep breath… feel this moment, the flavors of life flowing gently on the breeze.

name: Skia
title: ETD-4, Lieutenant
desc:
Kesan positif pertama Skia terhadap Biro muncul saat ia memperbarui resumenya.
Ia memutuskan mencoba pekerjaan di Biro saat diundang untuk melamar, tetapi formalitas resume tetap diperlukan. Sejak meninggalkan pekerjaan sebelumnya, ia tak pernah lagi memikirkan resume dan lamaran kerja… Kini mau tak mau ia harus memoles resume lamanya.
 Ia mengunggah pas foto baru untuk menggantikan yang lama (ia hampir tidak mengenali pemuda di foto itu lagi), lalu menekan kirim.
 Biasanya di tahap inilah sistem akan memberitahunya "wajah tidak terdeteksi, silakan unggah foto yang sesuai" dan semacamnya. Anehnya, berkas itu terkirim tanpa masalah.
 Skia menghela napas lega pelan-pelan. Meski ia sudah lama tidak peduli menghadapi prasangka karena penampilannya, harus repot bolak-balik demi menutupi kekurangan sistem dan mengacaukan alur kerjanya yang sudah mapan… itu benar-benar tak tertahankan.

profile.intro: Sering dikira kapten Regu 4, padahal ia letnannya.
profile.quote: Sibuk. Tinggalkan pesan.

stories.text:
Skia's name had once been praised by his old colleagues as having "quite the martial artist's spirit." Skia didn't care much for the supposed depth of his name. But he found quiet satisfaction in the act of writing it—each letter placed with purpose, each curve and line falling into place. It was neat, orderly, and well arranged. Just the way he liked.
However, whenever he signed his name with too much force, that scene would always reappear in his mind… That day when he signed his employment contract at his ex-company.
For that job, he completely embraced all the workplace etiquette his colleagues believed in as "standard practice," never questioning any of it. This included things like specialized signature training to leave clients with an elite impression.
It made perfect sense, really—if all it took to preserve one's dignity was to follow a visible, rigid set of rules, then the cost was laughably low for the rewards.

As for his current signature… the overall form remained rigorous, but a closer look revealed slightly hurried connecting strokes.
Had he stopped caring about these surface details? Had taking too much time off made him sloppy? Or perhaps it was the pressure from too many emergency missions piling up with all the cleanup…

Things weren't done the way he wanted. He felt he was the only one willing to maintain the system. Well… there was nothing he could do about that.
Despite that, he gradually got used to working at the BAC. And… how should he put it? He didn't mind the sincere jokes of his teammates.

On the other hand, there was a new cafeteria lady at the Bureau who was particularly enthusiastic about Skia.
When serving him food, though Skia hadn't said anything, she would ladle several extra bone-in ribs, then casually speak to another female staff member about how her son also likes chewing on those ribs.
The other woman lowered her voice, sounding embarrassed. "He… he's not an Oddity! He's the lieutenant from ETD-4!"
Skia quietly stared at the perfectly balanced, almost strict meal composition, topped with those extra bone-in ribs… then picked up his tray and walked away. In the end, he never asked about the "breed" of the lady's son.

stories.title: Office
stories.text:
At Leon International, Skia embodied the role of a regular office worker and was naturally suited for that kind of life.
In modern civilized society, the fact that awakening Esper Abilities could change physical appearance was already common knowledge. His transformation was indeed dramatic, and just one look gave him a worse shock than any he'd experienced in five years of work… but once he calmed down, there was nothing he couldn't rationalize. After all, it wasn't a job that depended on looks, so it shouldn't break his routine…
The truth was, his routine wasn't determined by his own mindset.
Back then, he'd stood up in the meeting room, unable to bear it any longer, forcing himself to remain polite as he asked why the projects he'd always handled weren't even going through him for reports anymore.
Sitting among the well-dressed elites around him, someone wrinkled their eyes forcefully. Skia later realized it was the kind of motion… like trying to squeeze out some murky substance that had fallen into their eye.
As the meeting adjourned, Skia raised his gaze, looking past the cracks in his self-imposed mask that he was forced to reexamine, his eyes meeting the massive silhouette in the center of the projection screen that rose with his standing figure.
Does he look like a monster to others?
Well, at least the price of gaining the Esper Ability's wasn't too high. Now he was a regular office worker in every way except appearance.

stories.title: Resignation
stories.text:
"It's like being a frog slowly boiled alive…"
While drinking, the man on his left complained to the bartender about his predicament. The man was troubled, trapped in a state where every fiber of his being couldn't relax due to workplace pressure. If he wanted to escape, he'd inevitably face brutal consequences. The man was deeply conflicted about this.
"Next time I see you here, I hope you won't be sipping your drink with such restraint… You can only break free if you break down completely for once. You don't cure alcohol by drinking a cure. You simply throw up."
The man sitting on his right, with a menacing aura and face of scars, responded across the space. His deliberate, unhurried way of speaking, which contrasted sharply with his appearance, caught Skia's attention.
Becoming friends with that person marked the beginning of Skia realizing that he had the ability to build a routine wherever he was.
If on that chaotic and dangerous path, there were rules, order, and clear objectives, then perhaps…

stories.title: Canine
stories.text:
The imposing black hound poked its head out from the hole carved by the lighter's flame, keeping watch. Once it discovered the lighter had been replaced, its ears flattened, showing signs of dejection.
"Did the hound really prefer the original lighter?" Skia wondered. But giving an explanation like "I'm not switching back because that one had my ex-company's logo" seemed foolish, inefficient, and overly formal… Communication with his own Esper Ability should done internally. After all, the ability was a reflection of himself.
The issue was shelved, and the final result was a naturally acceptance of this current form.

stories.title: Caffeine
stories.text:
A specialty coffee available for order from Ms. Fei.
Compared to the golden ratio morning coffee that Skia's ex-company mandated at 8:00 AM daily, this had… 3 extra sugar cubes, 25 ml extra milk, and… other ingredients that shouldn't appear in coffee. As for the coffee beans' origin… Well, perhaps it's from a different dimension. That was about the best way to describe the drink.
The coffee poured from Ms. Fei's head wasn't exactly brewed. The recipe isn't something one can expect—one had to taste it. But back then, Skia still tried to describe the drink with precise words.
Ms. Fei said she named the coffee after seeing Skia react to coffee she served him after he joined the BAC—it was as if he never had a real cup of coffee before. The look on his face was a mix of surprise and bewilderment, making it impossible to tell whether he was thinking it was absolutely delicious! or utterly awful!
Ms. Fei gave up asking about his preferences, and the long sigh that followed was enough to sum up all his thoughts.

stories.title: Order
stories.text:
If you ever eavesdrop on JTF members, you'd discover that Skia has quite a high reputation among them for being reliable, competent, and reasonable. They'd say that he has no weird temper and no strange hobbies, as well as other great qualities many of his colleagues lack!
"There are too many difficult people over there, honestly it's pretty scary. But working with Lieutenant Skia is incredibly easy. He's steady and skilled, he knows what documents I need to hand over better than I do. It's like he's been working for twenty years…"
 "Oh man, Skia has it so tough. He's bears burdens alone; he acts as the only pillar of order in group of weirdos; he's the sole boat stubbornly sailing against the current; he struggles to impose procedures amid a raging tide of individualism…"
Their analysis of his role and development prospects in ETD… somehow has a bitter aftertaste.

skills.quote: Akibat dari "ketidakpatuhan".

skills.name: Arrest Warrant
skills.desc: Bayangan yang tak kenal lelah ini tak bisa dihindari. Memerintahkan bayangan layaknya anjing polisi untuk menggigit target, memberikan 1 hit Lakshana DMG ke area.

skills.name: Suppression
skills.desc: Remora Enhancement: Menerapkan satu Remora tambahan pada target saat Fang Thrust mengunci target yang sedang dalam status Remora.
skills.quote: Biasanya tidak perlu turun tangan secara fisik: Skia bisa menaklukkan target hanya dengan bayangannya, sehingga fasilitas tetap utuh. Ditambah lagi, ia ikut membantu bersih-bersih… Menurut survei kantin BAC, 84% staf senang Skia datang ke lokasi kerja mereka. Tidak merepotkan!

skills.name: Apprehension
skills.desc: Meningkatkan DMG Fang Thrust sebesar 10% selama 15 detik setelah menggunakan The Pack, termasuk DMG tabrakan dalam mode Shadow Hound Gnaw.
skills.quote: Tubuhmu mungkin bebas bergerak, tapi bayanganmu dicengkeram erat sehingga kamu tak bisa bergerak… Sensasi yang cukup aneh.

skills.name: Shadow Hound
skills.desc:
Tahan tombol gerak dan Dodge untuk masuk ke mode Shadow Hound

Shadow Hound
Bersembunyi di dalam bayangannya, bisa bergerak di permukaan tanah maupun dinding.
Tidak bisa dideteksi musuh.
Kebal terhadap serangan tertentu, tetapi mode berakhir jika terkena DMG di permukaan tanah.
Tekan Basic Attack atau berganti karakter untuk membatalkan.
Mencapai tepi tempat tinggi lalu terus bergerak maju juga akan membatalkan mode ini.
skills.quote: Fadia pernah bertanya pada Skia, posisi tubuhnya terasa seperti apa saat tenggelam dalam bayangan. Karena tak bisa menjelaskannya, Skia menyuruhnya membayangkan sendiri. Ia lebih memilih tidak tahu bayangan apa yang muncul di kepala Fadia.

awakening.name: Process of Elimination
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan DMG Ratio serangan otomatis Fang Thrust sebesar 60%.

awakening.name: Law and Order
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan Crit Rate Skia sebesar 10% dan resistansi terhadap interupsi sebesar 50% selama 15 detik setelah menggunakan Shadow Hound Chase.

awakening.name: Solution
awakening.desc: DMG Skia ke target yang dikunci Fang Thrust meningkat 4%. Jika hanya ada satu target di medan yang dikunci Fang Thrust, DMG Skia ke target itu meningkat lagi 4%.

awakening.name: Resolution
awakening.desc: Memperpanjang durasi Tailed menjadi 12 detik. Attachment DMG meningkat 2% untuk setiap detik target ditempeli, hingga 40%.

awakening.name: Social Contract
awakening.desc: Untuk setiap Fang Thrust yang mengunci target, massa target bertambah 50 dan Movement Speed-nya berkurang 20%.

awakening.name: Unbothered Appearance
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan Extra DMG Ratio Fang Thrust sebesar 20% saat menyentuh musuh yang dikunci Fang Thrust dalam mode Shadow Hound Gnaw.

awakening.name: Cubical Survival Manual
awakening.desc: Meningkatkan level skill Arresting Art, Shadow Hound Chase, dan The Pack sebesar 1.

awakening.name: Employee of the Month
awakening.desc: Mengurangi Lakshana RES target yang dikunci sebesar 2% untuk setiap Fang Thrust, hingga 6%.

console.name: Cubical Survival Manual
console.desc: Meningkatkan level skill Arresting Art, Shadow Hound Chase, dan The Pack sebesar 1.

console.name: Employee of the Month
console.desc: Mengurangi Lakshana Resistance target yang dikunci sebesar 2% untuk setiap Fang Thrust, hingga 6%.
